review_kind: successor authority transaction correction for 0077 M06/M07

supersedes.disposition: 0077 M06 and M07 are corrected by this design, subject to a fresh independent Phase 0 verdict. 0075 M04/M05 closures remain required and are retained below. Earlier evidence is append-only.

authority_and_limits.authorization: OwnerDecision 0073 grants the bounded F4/core design authority for this sole-writer correction only.
authority_and_limits.phase: Design only. RED, implementation, merge, deployment, and real activity remain disabled until a fresh skeptic finds zero unresolved in-scope Critical/Major.
authority_and_limits.non_claim: This is one in-process concrete LifecycleAuthority instance. It does not claim an OS-owned durable ledger, restart recovery, cross-process lock, reconstruction, or a wider development-broker attacker model; those remain F5A-R23, not an excuse to weaken M06 or M07.

direct_legacy: CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.capture(published, frozen, port, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonce)
inventoried_current_surface.scope_rule: The base LifecycleAuthority ABC stays exactly produce/seal/publish/capture/open_capture, preserving v1 subclasses. The concrete P4 authority and every listed facade are required to route through the one arbitration primitive; an arbitrary unrelated v1 subclass is not represented as P4-capable.

CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.kind: opt-in concrete LifecycleAuthority subclass and the only P4 writer
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.input: captures is an exact built-in nonempty tuple of exact built-in (published, frozen, derived_port) tuples in complete PlannedCaptureSet order; admission_ref is an exact IssuanceBasisRef.v1 action-execution-admission or final-replay-admission reference; identities, run, SHA-256 values, and unique transition nonces meet 0076's retained closed grammar. No caller supplies artifact bytes, signer, resolver generation, ledger/store, path, URL, provider, callback, or session.
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.output: CapturedAuthorizationRecord and LaunchSession(kind='captured-authorization-v2') are opaque, noncopyable, nonpickleable, nonmapping, and identity-bound. P4 creates neither _Captured nor VerifiedCapture/CapturedBindings and exposes no member/provider/receipt/signer/store capability.

HistoricalStudyVerifier.method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
HistoricalStudyVerifier.rule: Requires its constructor-bound authority to be the exact P4-capable authority and delegates only to that authority's class method. It owns no lock, P4 map, admission state, receipt, session, or ledger write. capture remains a legacy facade and uses the same legacy arbitration route.

HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.rule: Requires and class-delegates only to its exact constructor-bound HistoricalStudyVerifier. It owns no authority state; substitution, subclass, duck, wrapper, copy, and pickle refuse.

CapturedAuthorizationContract.held_dependencies: Only the authority constructs and privately retains the contract, trusted resolver snapshot factory, Ed25519 keyring, trusted clock, and immutable revocation authority.
CapturedAuthorizationContract.denial: The contract has no reserve, consume, abort, commit, lookup, writer, admission-spend callback, session/event construction, member/provider open, import, construction, execution, or output method. It cannot observe or mutate the authority ledger.

LifecycleAuthorizationLedger.kind: private, authority-owned, in-process transactional WORM primitive; its one mutex is the LifecycleAuthority capture-transition lock
LifecycleAuthorizationLedger.p4_method: commit_p4_batch(*, live_identities, expected_published_heads, admission_identity, execution_key, prepared_batch, session_decision) -> _P4Committed | _P4Refused | _P4OutcomeUnknown
LifecycleAuthorizationLedger.authoritative_domain: One ledger record domain contains the per-live-identity head/claim, admission state, execution-key uniqueness index, complete canonical authorization batch, session identity, and SessionStartRecord. Admission consumption and batch publication are fields of the same immutable committed record, not two stores and not cross-store coordination.

authoritative_states.execution_key: canonical (study_id, canonical execution_authority_ref bytes, logical_execution_id, run_id)
invariants: Only PUBLISHED is admissible to either capture path.
LEGACY_COMMITTING and P4_RESERVING exist only while the one lock is held; they are neither observable public states nor ledger commits.
CAPTURED_V1 and P4_COMMITTED are terminal for the matched live identity within this authority instance.
An admission has no Reserved or Aborted authoritative state: before commit it remains UNUSED; after commit it is COMMITTED forever in this process.

A P4 committed record is one immutable WORM value containing consumed admission identity, ordered port bytes, ordered receipt bytes, set bytes, replay evidence or action-none, verified SessionDecision, session identity/nonce, SessionStartRecord, and frozen live projection.

single_lock_arbitration.lock_scope: Every direct legacy capture, P4 capture, verifier/driver delegation, and legacy open/bind/member/consume/release gate acquires or checks through the same authority-owned capture-transition lock and ledger state. No facade may perform a prior unlocked 'not P4' check.
legacy_commit: Validate legacy inputs outside and again inside the lock; inside compare exact live identity and PUBLISHED head.

Atomically transition PUBLISHED -> LEGACY_COMMITTING -> CAPTURED_V1 while appending the v1 CAPTURED receipt, binding/interning its legacy session, and recording its session-start identity as the legacy commit's one in-process result.
Release the lock only after the complete legacy commit. The returned legacy capability is ordinary v1 behavior.
Any P4 call entering later observes CAPTURED_V1, refuses before P4 reservation, and leaves zero P4 batch/session/event/admission effect.
p4_commit: Obtain immutable resolver snapshot and run contract prepare_batch plus verify_prepared_batch before entering the ledger. No authority effect occurs here.

Inside the one lock, compare every frozen live identity/head is exactly PUBLISHED, every transition nonce is unused, admission is UNUSED, and execution_key is absent. Then transition every identity PUBLISHED -> P4_RESERVING without releasing the lock.

Recheck the prepared batch against the locked live projection and all ADR-0125 field adjacency. The one logical commit order is: (1) consume admission in the committed record, then (2) publish/mint the complete already-verified port/receipt/set/replay batch plus session identity and SessionStartRecord, and transition all identities P4_RESERVING -> P4_COMMITTED.

No legacy route can run between reservation and complete commit. On a pre-commit refusal the lock-private reservation is discarded, each identity remains PUBLISHED, admission remains UNUSED, prepared data is destroyed, and a corrected retry is legal.
single_lock_arbitration.post_p4_denials: For P4_RESERVING or P4_COMMITTED, all listed legacy capture/open/bind/member/consume/release routes refuse before receipt, session, provider/member, import, construction, execution, output, or release effects. For P4_RESERVING this is enforced by the lock; for P4_COMMITTED it is a ledger-state refusal. Helper and construction routes cannot manufacture a P4 record or bypass the gate.

prepared_batch_is_not_issued.definition: _PreparedCapturedAuthorizationBatch is a private, non-exportable, nonserializable authority-local value. It may contain canonical signed candidate bytes only while the caller is inside authorize_capture_set; it has no public bytes accessor, artifact lookup key, resolver registration, store entry, execution-key binding, session identity, session-start record, or authority-valid status.
prepared_batch_is_not_issued.consequence: The signing operation in prepare_batch is preparation, not ADR-0125 issuance/minting. The bytes cannot be observed, returned, stored, resolved, used to open/capture/bind a member, or associated with admission/session state; any preparation or pre-commit failure destroys them. Only commit_p4_batch's single ledger publication confers authority, names them as issued artifacts, binds the admission/key/session, and makes the batch resolvable.
prepared_batch_is_not_issued.adr_order: Thus the first issued CapturedPortAuthorization is atomically preceded by the admission's consumption in the same committed WORM record. There is no signed-and-issued port before consumption and no rollback of a consumed admission.

transaction_failure_and_concurrency.preparation_failure: Resolver, canonical/schema/signature/basis/time/revocation, request, planned-set, live fingerprint, signer, or prepared-batch verification failure occurs before ledger entry; admission is UNUSED, all heads stay PUBLISHED, no batch/session/event/legacy receipt/provider/member effect exists, and retry is legal.
transaction_failure_and_concurrency.precommit_failure: A failure after P4_RESERVING but before the one ledger mutation clears only lock-private reservation. It cannot write, mint, publish, return, look up, or authorize any artifact. Admission remains UNUSED and retry is legal.
transaction_failure_and_concurrency.commit: commit_p4_batch is all-or-nothing: it either creates exactly one immutable record containing consumed admission plus complete batch/session start, or writes nothing. It cannot expose a partial port, receipt, set, replay evidence, session, or event.
transaction_failure_and_concurrency.unknown_outcome: If the primitive reports after an uncertain commit boundary, callers must call resolve_p4(execution_key, admission_identity). _P4Committed returns the same committed identity only; _Absent proves no commit and permits a fresh preparation. They never remint/resend first. A committed/consumed admission is never aborted or rolled back.
transaction_failure_and_concurrency.concurrency: Same execution_key, same admission, or any shared live identity serialize on the one lock. The first complete legacy or P4 transition wins; a same-key P4 contender sees the exact committed record/refusal, while a contender after an explicitly precommit-aborted P4 attempt may retry. Different key/admission contenders sharing an identity also serialize and cannot split its route.

adr0125_and_prior_closures_retained.M04_basis_closure: A held caller-unselectable immutable TrustedArtifactResolver snapshot recursively resolves every signed artifact, IssuanceBasis.v1, and exact ref; it verifies canonical grammar, named self, Ed25519, role/use, time/revocation, closed basis/ref set, no cycle/future output, and full action/replay adjacency before preparation.
adr0125_and_prior_closures_retained.M05_start_closure: Session identity/nonce and canonical SessionStartRecord are fields of the same P4 committed record. Post-commit opaque interning/return performs no new authority effect; an intern failure resolves the existing record rather than creating a second session/event.
required_artifact_adjacency: P(CES)==P(BVP)==P(CAS)==P(StageAdmission or FinalReplayEntry)==ordered PlannedCaptureSet==ordered live captures by complete PCE bytes/cardinality.

Each PCE has exactly one v2 port and v2 receipt; receipt binds its PCE/port, predecessor publication schema/digest, stream sequence/predecessor, consumer kind/id, runtime digest, and WORM-unique nonce.

Set and replay evidence are strict planned-entry-order projections; action has action-none replay evidence, replay has exact FinalManifest/FinalReplayAdmission/FinalReplayEntry/intent and issued_ports equal the set triples.
Session decision matches study, execution authority ref, logical execution, run, document, BVP, set self, process measurement, purpose, time, and the committed live identities.

M06_schedules.schedule: Legacy direct capture acquires the shared transition lock first, commits v1 CAPTURED head/session/receipt, then direct P4 enters.
M06_schedules.assert: P4 refuses at locked PUBLISHED comparison; no P4 reservation/batch/session-start/admission mutation occurs.

M06_schedules.schedule: P4 reaches lock first, marks every identity P4_RESERVING, pauses before logical commit; direct legacy capture, verifier.capture, and driver.capture attempt concurrently.
M06_schedules.assert: All block/refuse through the same lock; none append v1 receipt or return legacy session. Resume commits only P4 complete batch.

M06_schedules.schedule: P4 commits, then invoke each direct/verifier/driver legacy capture plus open_capture, captured_bindings, member, read_bytes/read_text, require/_consume_binding, and release using P4-related identities.
M06_schedules.assert: Each refuses before legacy receipt/session/member/provider/import/construct/run/output/release effect; ordinary unrelated v1 capture remains positive.

M06_schedules.schedule: Two P4 calls share one identity but differ in key/admission; two calls share key/admission; a legacy and P4 start on a barrier repeatedly.
M06_schedules.assert: Exactly one full winner per identity; no check-then-act window, mixed v1/P4 history, duplicate session, or partial P4 effect.

M07_schedules.schedule: prepare_batch or verify_prepared_batch fails before transaction; repeat with corrected evidence.
M07_schedules.assert: No authoritative artifact/session/event/ledger lookup exists, admission remains UNUSED, and retry succeeds.

M07_schedules.schedule: Instrument prepared signed candidate bytes before commit and attempt bytes/dict/pickle/lookup/store/key/session/member access; then force receipt/set/replay/revalidation failure while P4_RESERVING.
M07_schedules.assert: All access refuses; no issue exists, reservation clears, admission is UNUSED, and corrected retry is legal.

M07_schedules.schedule: At commit spy the logical mutation order and inject faults immediately before it and immediately after the immutable record publish; call resolve_p4.
M07_schedules.assert: Before: no record and UNUSED. After: one record shows admission consumed before complete batch/session-start publication; resolve returns same record, never remints, aborts, or rolls back.

M07_schedules.schedule: Concurrent same admission/key contenders and action/replay one- and multi-PCE success cases.
M07_schedules.assert: One serialized committed WORM record holds both admission consumption and complete exact batch; no second session/event and no separate admission/batch store coordination.

retained_family: All request/cardinality/order/duplicate/live/head/run/runtime/nonce mutations, resolver/basis/ref/key/use/signature/time/revocation/cycle/future substitutions, and ADR-0125 field/self/preimage/ordering/adjacency mutations.
Issuer/preparation ordering and no effect before commit; malformed/aliased/post-return mutation; action/replay multiple happy paths; no import/open/construct/run/output/release.
Existing tests/pipeline/test_trust.py, tests/production/test_capture_lifecycle.py, and tests/production/test_adr0125_preflight.py retain ordinary-v1 and Packet 3 positives.
